title: Ladder
body:
Appearance


Description: "Ladder_description"

The ladder is a schematic that can be bought from Illumine Designs for $340, and once bought, doesn't need to be bought again unless you purposely forget the schematic. It allows you to place, well, a ladder in your property that can be filled with any material and can be scaled up to (height needed)studs x (width needed)studs.
